name: Gx Amp
_comment: Insert effect: Guitarix's guitar amp (tube models, tonestacks, cabinets, pedals, reverb; vendored in gx/) for a real guitar on an audio input and for RiffBox. vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. The plugin is gxamp_vst.cpp + gx/, built by this port's own build.sh.
